question: What shared essential nature is attributed to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra?
premises: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are named.
They are collectively included as all.
They are described as having the form of the own āgama.
inference: The three principal deities all have the form of the own āgama.
plain_english: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra—all of them have the form of one's own āgama.
